title: Bachelors Degree In Cyber Security (BS-CS)
description: Gain in-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in safeguarding digital systems and data in today’s interconnected world.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and UCAM Catholic University of Murcia
longDescription: This bachelor's degree equips students with the technical and analytical skills to combat modern cyber threats. It covers core topics like computer systems, networks, cyber forensics, cryptography, and ethical hacking. Students also explore programming, data science, system design, and human factors in cybersecurity. Practical placement opportunities allow learners to apply knowledge in real-world environments. Graduates will be prepared for dynamic cybersecurity, IT security, and digital forensics careers.
courseDetails: The programme includes modules in secure programming, cybercrime investigation, web and mobile development, and advanced networking. Students develop skills in risk analysis, penetration testing, data analytics, and cryptographic protocol implementation. They learn to assess system vulnerabilities, design secure solutions, and manage digital infrastructures. Real-world application is supported through placements and project-based learning.
courseDetailParagraphs: The programme includes modules in secure programming, cybercrime investigation, web and mobile development, and advanced networking. Students develop skills in risk analysis, penetration testing, data analytics, and cryptographic protocol implementation. They learn to assess system vulnerabilities, design secure solutions, and manage digital infrastructures. Real-world application is supported through placements and project-based learning.
entry: For entry into Bachelor's Degree in Cyber Security, learners must possess the following:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Result can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Result. (This is assessed on a case by case basis)
* Learner must be 18 years or older at the start of the Course.
* Mature Learners (21 years or older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to be awarded with a bachelor's degree programme from the UCAM Catholic University Of Murcia.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
certificateDetails: You will receive two degrees from GSS Partner Universities.

Obtain a degree without necessarily leaving your country.

modules.title: Computers And Security
modules.summary: This module introduces fundamental computing concepts and security principles, focusing on hardware, software, and cyber threats. Students will explore basic security mechanisms and best practices for protecting computer systems.

modules.title: Principles Of Cyber Forensics
modules.summary: This module covers the principles of cyber forensics, including digital evidence collection, analysis, and legal considerations. It focuses on forensic investigation techniques to detect and respond to cybercrimes.

modules.title: Principles Of Programming
modules.summary: This module provides foundational programming knowledge, covering algorithms, data structures, and problem-solving techniques. It introduces structured and object-oriented programming principles.

modules.title: Maths For Data Science
modules.summary: This module focuses on mathematical foundations for data science, including linear algebra, probability, and statistics. It provides essential skills for data analysis, machine learning, and cybersecurity applications.

modules.title: Systems Design
modules.summary: This module explores system design methodologies, focusing on designing secure and scalable computing systems. It includes requirements analysis, architecture design, and implementation strategies.

modules.title: Web Development
modules.summary: This module introduces modern web development technologies and security practices. Students learn to build secure, responsive web applications using front-end and back-end technologies.

modules.title: Data Analytics
modules.summary: This module focuses on data analysis techniques, including data visualization, machine learning, and predictive modeling. It explores data-driven decision-making in cybersecurity contexts.

modules.title: Operating Systems
modules.summary: This module covers operating system concepts, including process management, memory management, and security mechanisms. It provides insights into Linux and Windows security.

modules.title: Cryptography & Security
modules.summary: This module explores cryptographic techniques used for data protection. It covers encryption, hashing, digital signatures, and secure communications.

modules.title: Network Design & Configuration
modules.summary: This module covers the principles of designing and configuring secure networks. It includes IP addressing, routing, switching, and network security.

modules.title: Ethical Hacking & Security
modules.summary: This module introduces ethical hacking principles, focusing on penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and exploit mitigation techniques.

modules.title: Artificial Intelligence
modules.summary: This module explores AI applications in cybersecurity, including machine learning, deep learning, and automated threat detection.

modules.title: Cyber Human Factors
modules.summary: This module examines human behavior in cybersecurity, focusing on social engineering, security awareness, and risk management.

modules.title: Computing Technology Placement
modules.summary: This module provides students with industry experience, allowing them to apply theoretical knowledge in real-world cybersecurity environments.

modules.title: Advanced Networking & Security
modules.summary: This module covers advanced networking concepts, focusing on security mechanisms, network protocols, and secure communication strategies in large-scale networks.

modules.title: Cyber Security
modules.summary: This module provides an in-depth understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat landscapes, and security frameworks used to protect digital assets.

modules.title: Systems Analysis And Design
modules.summary: This module focuses on analyzing and designing secure information systems, covering requirements engineering, system modeling, and development methodologies.

modules.title: Web And Mobile Applications
modules.summary: This module explores the development and security of web and mobile applications, focusing on secure coding practices and vulnerability mitigation.

modules.title: Computer And Network Technology
modules.summary: This module provides foundational knowledge of computer hardware, networking, and system integration, essential for cybersecurity professionals.

modules.title: Managing Digital Information
modules.summary: This module covers the management, protection, and ethical considerations of digital information, emphasizing data governance and security.

modules.title: Information Technology Security
modules.summary: This module explores security policies, frameworks, and technologies used to protect IT systems from cyber threats and attacks.

modules.title: Principles Of Computer Science
modules.summary: This module introduces fundamental computer science concepts, including algorithms, data structures, and computational theory, essential for cybersecurity applications.

modules.title: Thesis
modules.summary: Here, in this segment, you will produce an academic standard research thesis.

outcomes: Demonstrate an understanding of computer systems, network architecture, and cybersecurity principles to effectively identify and mitigate security threats.
Apply principles of cyber forensics and ethical hacking to investigate cybercrimes and assess system vulnerabilities using appropriate tools and techniques.
Design, develop, and test secure software applications using structured programming concepts, algorithms, and modern development tools.
Utilize mathematical and statistical techniques to support data-driven decision-making in data science and analytics projects.
Apply system design and analysis methodologies to develop robust, user-centred digital systems and technology solutions.
Develop interactive and responsive websites and mobile applications using modern web development frameworks and technologies.
Evaluate and implement cryptographic algorithms and protocols to secure data in transit and at rest, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality.
Manage and configure modern operating systems and computer networks for optimal performance, scalability, and security.
Analyse and address human factors in cybersecurity, including user behaviour, social engineering, and the psychology of cyber threats.
Demonstrate industry-ready skills through practical placement experience, applying computing technologies and cybersecurity knowledge to real-world problems.
